peg.volatility_score_basis: MEASURES NAV BEHAVIOUR ON A SHARE WITH NO DIRECTIONAL PEG — there is nothing here that is supposed to equal $1, so deviation-from-par is the wrong instrument entirely. Feed: market 1.246699 against NAV 1.247473, a −6.2bp discount, i.e. the mark is essentially uncontested. ⚠️ THE SCORE IS HELD DOWN BY AN ARCHITECTURE PIVOT IN THE UNDERLYING USDe, NOT BY OBSERVED NAV BEHAVIOUR — the accrual has been well-behaved, and what is priced is that the mechanism generating it is changing. ⚠️ SO A SMOOTH NAV SERIES IS NOT EVIDENCE AGAINST THIS SCORE: it measures forward mechanism risk, and the history was generated by the arrangement being replaced.
peg.volatility_score_persistence: filtered — underlying mechanism, not spot price

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES THE BREADTH OF REAL EXIT ROUTES, AND IT IS THE HIGHEST LIQUIDITY SCORE IN THIS ROLLOUT. Deep Curve sUSDe/USDe and sUSDe/USDC pools PLUS Pendle PT/YT markets, so retail can exit on the secondary without touching the cooldown. ⚠️ THE PENDLE LEG IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF EXIT AND IS COUNTED DELIBERATELY: selling a PT is exiting the position at a yield-implied price, not redeeming the share, so it broadens routes without being a par exit.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue breadth, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️⚠️ THE FEED'S total_2pct_depth OF $2,000,000 SITS BESIDE THIS 7.0 AND WILL READ AS A FLAT CONTRADICTION. IT IS NOT ONE. is_floor is true and status is 'ladder_exhausted' — the ladder RAN OUT at its top rung without resolving a 2% crossing, so $2M is the largest size ATTEMPTED, not the depth found. ⚠️ ON A $1,368,057,913 BOOK, $2M WOULD BE 0.15% AND WOULD BE ALARMING IF IT WERE A MEASUREMENT. It is not. The 7.0 rests on named venues — two Curve pools and the Pendle markets — and the correct reading of the feed field is 'the probe did not reach far enough to bound this asset'.
